name: Tsuma ga Netorare Arbeit ~Charao no Kyokon ni Haiboku Shita Yome~
original_name: 妻が寝取られアルバイト ～チャラ男の巨根に敗北した嫁～
source:
“I’ve been thinking… I want to get a part-time job.”
The sudden announcement from my wife, Riko, left me frozen in place.

“If we’re going to have kids and raise them… I thought it’d be good to save up as much money as we can.”

“I get it. If that’s how you feel, then go ahead. Just… keep it to daytime hours, okay?”

Humming happily, Riko immediately pulled out her phone and started looking for part-time jobs.

Looking back now…
Maybe letting her take that job was the root of everything that went wrong…
Every day, she seemed so happy working her part-time job. I never imagined she’d end up doing… that.

translation:
“我一直在想……我想找一份兼职工作。”
妻子莉子突然宣布的消息让我愣在原地。

“如果我们要生孩子并抚养他们……我认为尽可能多存钱会很好。”

“我明白了。如果你有这种感觉，那就继续吧。只要……保持在白天，好吗？”

莉子开心地哼着歌，立刻掏出手机开始找兼职工作。

现在回想起来……
也许让她接受那份工作是一切问题的根源……
每天，她看起来都很高兴做着兼职工作。我从没想过她最终会这么做……那样。
